Let me start the Tomcat instances. That's the core.

Wait — when I run `source /opt/mapserver/env.sh`, and then run shp2img in the same shell, the variables should be set. Unless... the shell environment isn't being passed. Let me verify. Actually, let me just do it cleanly and test.

action.command:
source /etc/xplanbox.env
export CATALINA_PID=/opt/tomcat-dienste/tomcat.pid
/opt/tomcat-dienste/bin/startup.sh 2>&1
sleep 5
/opt/tomcat-anwendung/bin/startup.sh 2>&1
sleep 5
/opt/tomcat-api/bin/startup.sh 2>&1
sleep 5
echo "=== java/tomcat processes ==="
ps aux | grep -E "[c]atalina|[t]omcat" | grep -v grep | awk '{print $2, $11, $12}' | head
